yaml:
flow:
  - id: validate
    name: Validate
    kind: check
    by: agent
    model: default
    skill: otaq:validate
    rounds: 3
    fail_to: Dev
    description: "Checks the work against the ticket and runs the project's checks, so what Dev missed is caught before anyone reviews it."
  - id: dev
    name: Dev
    kind: agent
    model: default
    skill: otaq:work-ticket
    description: "Builds what the ticket asks for, with its tests, and commits it: every ticket that changes the code needs it."
  - id: review
    name: Review
    kind: check
    by: you
    description: "The user reads the change and passes it, or sends it back with what to fix: their say before it is delivered."
delivery:
  delivers: either
  mode: click
  model: default
  skill: otaq:open-pr

who.heading: Who does it

menu.title: Pick a model…

menu.foot: A model name without a version always means that tool’s newest.

picker.hint: Any model of a tool on this Mac. Every ticket at this stage uses it; it changes only here.

who.instructions_hint: Added to the skill for every ticket at this stage.

picker.title: Pick a skill…

items.label: otaq:address-review
items.hint: An agent fixes what you sent back from review, then hands the ticket back to you.

items.label: otaq:answer-question
items.hint: An agent answers a linked ticket’s question from this finished ticket’s work, changing nothing.

items.label: otaq:commit
items.hint: An agent commits every change in the ticket’s own copy of the repo.

items.label: otaq:flow
items.hint: Noyan changes the project’s flow: its agents and stages.

items.label: otaq:noyan
items.hint: Noyan, the project’s coordinator, turns what you ask for into tickets.

items.label: otaq:open-pr
items.hint: A pull request opens on GitHub; your team reviews it there.

items.label: otaq:push
items.hint: An agent pushes the ticket’s new commits to its pull request once their messages are confirmed.

items.label: otaq:restack
items.hint: An agent brings the ticket’s branch up to date with the branch it merges into.

items.label: otaq:validate
items.hint: A checking agent runs the tests and lint. If something fails, the ticket goes back to the stage before.

items.label: otaq:work-ticket
items.hint: An agent writes the code in the ticket’s own copy of the repo (a worktree).

items.label: tuq:milestone-plan
items.hint: An agent writes the ticket’s plan: the pieces, their order and what each waits for.

items.label: tuq:product-spec
items.hint: An agent asks you what to build, for whom and why, then writes down what you agreed.

items.label: tuq:step-back
items.hint: An agent steps back from a feature’s decisions and names the ones adding the most complication.

items.label: tuq:tech-spec
items.hint: An agent works out how to build it, asking you where a choice matters, and writes it down.

ask.label: Ask the agent to write it…
ask.hint: Starts Noyan on the right and uses tokens.
